name: workflow-shellcheck-findings-deferred
body: The gate's workflow step runs `actionlint -shellcheck=` so embedded-shell style findings are not gated. Limit: three pre-existing shellcheck findings in this workflow stay unsurfaced — SC2035 twice around line 239 and SC2001 around line 246 — and a real shell defect in the workflow would not be caught by the gate either. The flag is deliberate: linting the embedded shell would turn those pre-existing findings into a red gate for every agent on a machine with shellcheck installed, and a machine-dependent pass/fail (shellcheck is ambient, not a repo dependency). Upgrade by fixing the three findings, then dropping `-shellcheck=` from the gate step so the workflow's embedded shell is linted.
